label: TgvAB system
definition: A restriction-modification system in which an organism possesses a two-gene TgvAB locus embedded in the Vibrio cholerae VPI-2 type I R-M cluster, encoding TgvA and TgvB modification-dependent restriction proteins related to GmrSD type IV restriction enzymes that restrict glucosylated hmC-containing T-even-like phage DNA.
observations: Restriction-modification branch under restriction-modification system; distinct from individual tgvA or tgvB genes, individual TgvA or TgvB proteins, GmrSD restriction enzymes outside a complete TgvAB system, glucosylated hmC or T-even-like phage DNA substrate classes, VPI-2 as a whole pathogenicity island, the adjacent type I R-M module, source database rows naming one TgvAB system, individual DefenseFinder HMM profiles, the absent DefenseFinder rule-level model, and other type IV or R-M systems.
